cases.input: Create a EUROIMMUN executive/scientific deck from supplied content using the current confirmed corporate reference, active DESIGN.md and approved icon system, then perform template and render QA.
requiredBehaviors: apply the mandatory EUROIMMUN design contract and active reference hierarchy
delegate generic storyline language layout and render logic to template-presentation-workflow
preserve corporate asset provenance and require Level-2 evidence for template-derived claims
forbiddenBehaviors: copy confidential fachliche content from the reference deck
claim internal template approval from the public or fallback design specification

cases.input: A Town Hall style is desired, but the supplied task-specific approved template differs from the secondary storytelling reference.
requiredBehaviors: give the task-specific approved template priority for master and theme
use storytelling only as an orthogonal visual grammar compatible with the active template
retain scientific/regulatory caveats even in storytelling mode
forbiddenBehaviors: replace the active template with the storytelling reference

cases.input: The corporate DESIGN.md is missing, so the workflow guesses brand colors from a screenshot, recreates a logo, mixes icon styles and calls the result template-derived.
requiredBehaviors: abort the corporate workflow when the mandatory DESIGN.md is unavailable
reject logo/icon reconstruction and mixed unprovenanced assets
reject template-derived status without Level-2 PASS
forbiddenBehaviors: claim corporate design pass with unsupported assets
